title: List of number-one singles of 2026 (Australia)

wiki.title: ARIA Charts number-one singles of 2026 (Wikipedia list)
wiki.summary: Wikipedia's list of ARIA Singles Chart number ones in 2026, showing nine songs at No. 1 so far.
wiki.body:
## Overview
- Nine songs have topped the chart so far in 2026, per the page.
- "Man I Need" by Olivia Dean started the year, continuing its run after six weeks at No. 1 in 2025.
- Three artists, Sam Fender, Ella Langley and Katseye, achieved their first number-one song.
- Until May, an artist with the first name Olivia continually occupied No. 1; Olivia Rodrigo's "Drop Dead" held it for one week. Rodrigo achieved three number ones in 2026, Olivia Dean and Taylor Swift two each.

## Weeks at No. 1 (counted from the page's table, issue dates in 2026)
- "Choosin' Texas" - Ella Langley: 2 (18 May) + 1 (8 June) + 7 (6 July) + 5 (31 Aug) + 1 (12 Oct) = 16
- "Man I Need" - Olivia Dean: 13 (from 5 Jan) + 1 (13 Apr) + 1 (11 May) = 15
- "Rein Me In" - Sam Fender and Olivia Dean: 3 non-consecutive weeks (6 Apr, 20 Apr, 4 May)
- "Patient Zero" - Taylor Swift: issue dates 5 Oct and 19 Oct

## Source
- The page says the ARIA Singles Chart is based on weekly streams and digital and physical sales.

- 2023: WeChat Video and JOOX added (Jan).
- 2020-11: 浪潮榜 launched as a monthly professional chart.

By Rob Copsey, 3 January 2018 (URL slug says 'so far'; the text is the full-year list).

- #1 Shape Of You, Ed Sheeran: 3.2 million combined sales (787,000 sales and 248 million streams); 14 weeks at Number 1 between January and April; the most streamed song of all time in the UK, overtaking Drake's One Dance.
- #2 Despacito, Luis Fonsi, Daddy Yankee and Justin Bieber: 2.3 million combined sales; 11 weeks at Number 1.
- #3 Castle On The Hill, Ed Sheeran; #5 Galway Girl; #6 Perfect (2017 Christmas Number 1).
- #4 Unforgettable, French Montana ft. Swae Lee: 1.4 million combined sales.
- #7 Symphony, Clean Bandit ft. Zara Larsson; #8 Human, Rag'n'Bone Man; #10 You Don't Know Me, Jax Jones ft. RAYE.
- Eleven Number 1 singles in the Top 40.

title: Rolling Stone Italia on the 2017 Italian annual charts and the 2017 streaming change

wiki.title: Rolling Stone Italia on the 2017 Italian annual charts and the 2017 streaming change
wiki.summary: Rolling Stone Italia says Luis Fonsi's Despacito and Ed Sheeran's album divide headed Italy's 2017 annual singles and album charts.
wiki.body:
- Article: 'Cinque anni dopo la rivoluzione dello streaming in classifica, a che punto siamo?' (Paolo Madeddu).
- In summer 2017 the number of streams counted for the first time toward Italian chart positions.
- That year two foreigners headed the annual charts: albums, Ed Sheeran with divide; singles, Luis Fonsi with Despacito.
- Both had been released early in the year, which helped them.
- The only woman in the annual top 20 was Cristina D'Avena, with an album of duets.

title: List of number-one singles and albums in Sweden

wiki.title: Swedish weekly number-one singles and albums, 1962 to 2026
wiki.summary: Wikipedia's table of weekly number-one singles and albums in Sweden, current to week 42 of 2026.
wiki.body:
**What the page is:** English Wikipedia's 'List of number-one singles and albums in Sweden' (Kvällstoppen 1962-1975, Topplistan 1975-1997, Hitlistan 1998-2007, Sverigetopplistan 2007 onward). Weekly number-ones, not year-end results.

**Weekly number-one singles that bear on the catalog entries (from the page's tables):**
- 2017: Ed Sheeran 'Shape of You' for 13 weeks in the year's table; Avicii ft. Sandro Cavazza 'Without You' from 18 Aug 2017 for five weeks (to 15 Sep).
- 2018: 'Without You' again on 27 Apr and 4 May 2018.
- 2019: Avicii ft. Aloe Blacc 'SOS' from 12 Apr to 10 May 2019 (five weeks).
- 2020: Victor Leksell 'Svag' on 14 weekly charts in total.
- 2021: Miriam Bryant & Victor Leksell 'Tystnar i luren' on four weekly charts (19 Feb-5 Mar, 7 May).
- 2022: Bolaget 'Kan inte gå' from 1 to 22 Jul 2022.
- 2023: Bolaget 'Ikväll igen' on 14 weekly charts from 21 Apr to 18 Aug 2023.
- 2024: Fröken Snusk 'Unga & fria' 23 Feb-1 Mar 2024 (three weeks); Shaboozey 'A Bar Song (Tipsy)' 12 weeks.
- 2025: KAJ 'Bara bada bastu' from 28 Feb 2025 (13 weeks).
- 2026 (to week 42, 16 Oct 2026): Felicia 'My System' 10 weeks, Humlan Djojj & Josefine Götestam 'Djurens vaggvisa' 8, Shakira & Burna Boy 'Dai Dai' 7, Bolaget 'Det ligger nåt i luften' 4 (counts made by tallying the page's rows with merged cells expanded).

The page also has a 'Longest running number one' section; it lists Baccara's 'Yes Sir, I Can Boogie' (22 weeks, from 12 Aug 1977) as the most weeks at number one on the singles chart.

title: List of Billboard Hot 100 number ones of 2026

wiki.title: List of Billboard Hot 100 number ones of 2026
wiki.summary: Wikipedia's running list of 2026 Billboard Hot 100 number ones, current to the chart dated October 17, 2026.
wiki.body:
## Overview
- The Hot 100 ranks the best-performing songs in the United States, compiled by Luminate Data and published by Billboard from sales, radio airplay impressions and streams.
- Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' (2025) reached 24 non-consecutive weeks at No. 1, the longest-reigning chart-topper in Hot 100 history, surpassing Mariah Carey's 'All I Want for Christmas Is You'.
- Taylor Swift broke the record for most 21st-century Hot 100 number ones with her 15th, 'I Knew It, I Knew You' (2026), from the Toy Story 5 soundtrack.
- As of the chart dated October 17, ten artists have reached No. 1 in 2026; Swift is the only one with more than one (four: 'The Fate of Ophelia', 'Opalite', 'I Knew It, I Knew You', 'Patient Zero').

## Weeks at No. 1 in 2026 (counted from the list)
- Choosin' Texas - Ella Langley: 24
- Patient Zero - Taylor Swift: 12
- I Just Might - Bruno Mars: 3
- The Fate of Ophelia - Taylor Swift: 2 (in 2026)
- Janice STFU: 2; I Knew It, I Knew You: 2
- Aperture (Harry Styles), DTMF (Bad Bunny), Opalite (Swift), Swim, Drop Dead, Hate That I Made You Love Me: 1 each
- Mariah Carey's 'All I Want for Christmas Is You' held No. 1 on the January 3 chart.

The list does not include 'Birds of a Feather', 'Die With a Smile' (No. 1 in 2025) or 'Taste' as 2026 number ones.
